Hi! Remember me?
I’m one of Professor Oak’s assistants.\c
The professor told me that if your Pokédex has
good data on 30 species of Pokémon, I’m to
give you the Judge function.\c
So, [VAR TRNAME(0000)], let me ask you...\c
Have you gathered data on at least 30 species
of Pokémon?

Great!
You have caught [VAR NUM3(0004)] species of Pokémon!\c
Congratulations!
Now, let me update your Pokémon Box!
Your Pokémon Box gained the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Judge function[VAR COLOR(0000)]!
View a Pokémon’s summary via your Pokémon\nBox, and you’ll be able to see their potential.

Let’s see...
Uh-oh! You’ve only caught [VAR NUM3(0004)] different species
of Pokémon!\c
You’ve got to reach 30 species if you want
the Judge function.
...Oh, I see.\c\nWhen you get 30 species of Pokémon, come\nback for the Judge function.
